dedupe_keys.name: コミュニティハス 宮若 飯塚線 bus and public transit

description: コミュニティバス(宮若・飯塚線) [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 飯塚市. 飯塚市のコミュニティバス（宮若・飯塚線）の時刻表、経路、バス停の位置情報等が含まれた情報(標準的なバス情報フォーマット). Coverage: 飯塚市. The portal files it under the publisher 飯塚市. Its tags are GTFS-JP, コミュニティバス. It offers 7 resource(s) in gtfs-jp, zip. The portal shows 2026-04-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
